description.zh: 指定发起请求的来源，固定值为**honeypot**。
description.en: The source of the request. Set the value to **honeypot**.

description.zh:
指定请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

description.zh: 指定需要查询的数据的时间范围。单位为天。
description.en: The time range of the data to query. Unit: days.

description.zh:
指定需要查询的资产类型。取值：
- **vpcInstanceId**：VPC实例
- **uuid**：服务器
description.en:
The Asset Type to query. Valid values:
- **vpcInstanceId**: VPC-connected instance
- **uuid**: server

title.zh: 查询安全告警数排名前5的VPC或资产信息
title.en: Query top 5 vPCs or assets by security alert count

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-honey-pot-susp-statistics --from honeypot --statistics-key-type vpcInstanceId --statistics-days 30 --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeHoneyPotSuspStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --StatisticsKeyType vpcInstanceId --StatisticsDays 30 --Lang zh --From honeypot
